description: Generate CSS gradient code. Supports linear, radial, and conic gradients with direction, stops, and browser prefixes.

colors.description: Array of colors (strings) or color stops ({color, position}). Minimum 2.

direction.description: Direction/shape. Linear: 'to right', '45deg'. Radial: 'circle at center', 'ellipse at top'. Conic: 'from 0deg at center'.

name: css_gradient
